viewer: Hindi-speaking students and young adults, 15-30, who take overnight sleeper trains
hook: A stranger on an overnight sleeper asks to be woken at Itarsi, and says he hasn't been able to wake up for twelve years.
payoff: Whoever sleeps through their own station never leaves the coach. The narrator wakes the uncle, frees him, falls asleep, misses Bhopal, and becomes the next one asking a stranger to wake him.
sources: Original story. Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS (Aman), code-synthesized sound. No third-party footage, images or audio.
title: Upar Wali Berth
belief_label: Invented story; no real train, coach or incident. Itarsi and Bhopal are real stations on the same line (Itarsi before Bhopal going north).

story.setup: Overnight sleeper coach S7. The uncle on the opposite berth asks to be woken at Itarsi.

rule_or_clue.text: his paper ticket is dated 14 June 2014, twelve years old
rule_or_clue.line: तारीख, चौदह जून, दो हज़ार चौदह।

rule_or_clue.text: whoever sleeps through their station never leaves this coach
rule_or_clue.line: अंकल बोले, अपना स्टेशन सोते हुए मत निकालना। कहते हैं, जो निकाल दे, वो इस डिब्बे से नहीं उतरता।

escalation.text: the train stops where there is no station
escalation.line: रात दो बजे, ट्रेन ऐसी जगह रुकी जहाँ कोई स्टेशन नहीं था।

escalation.text: the uncle is not breathing but his open eyes watch the narrator
escalation.line: अंकल की छाती हिल नहीं रही थी। पर उनकी आँखें मेरे साथ घूम रही थीं।

escalation.text: every passenger holds the same old ticket
escalation.line: हर बर्थ पे लोग लेटे थे। सबके हाथ में वही पुराना टिकट।

false_relief.text: Itarsi arrives, the uncle wakes, smiles and gets off
false_relief.line: फिर इटारसी आया। मैंने अंकल को हिलाया। वो मुस्कुराए, और उतर गए।

twist.text: the narrator slept through Bhopal and his own ticket has yellowed
twist.line: मेरा टिकट अब पीला पड़ चुका है।
twist.how: The hook's 'twelve years and couldn't wake up' is the rule in action: the uncle slept through his station and was stuck until someone woke him; the narrator closes his eyes for one moment, sleeps past Bhopal, and now his own ticket ages the way the uncle's did.

ending_image.text: the narrator, now on the opposite berth with a yellowed paper ticket, speaks to a sleepy boy

callback.text: the hook's request repeated by the narrator with his own station
callback.line: सामने वाली बर्थ पे एक लड़का है। बेटा, भोपाल आए तो उठा देना।
